analogy.rationale: Beta lactamase inhibitors are anti-infective agents that target bacterial enzymes and have no annotated human targets, so they should produce little or no transcriptional response in human cell lines; the closest listed classes are other antibacterial/anti-infective mechanisms, which are also expected to be largely inactive in these cells.
